post.originalText:
🚨 CLAUDE AND GEMINI USERS!! 👽🍔

The story and the prompt:
Aliens stop for burgers… but they LOVE the food on Earth too much 😂

A 15-second Three.js short. Both HIGH.

GEMINI ARGON (browser chat) 
vs CLAUDE OPUS 5.5 (claude cli + toolings)

→ TIME: ~8–10 min vs 31m54s
→ TOKENS: Argon ~27.6K vs Opus 5.35M
→ API COST: Argon ~$0.92 vs Opus ~$6.63
→ SPEED: Argon ~46–57 TPS vs Opus ~97.2 TPS

WEEKLY: Argon was around ~1% 
vs Opus close to 0%!!!

Argon finished around 3× FASTER, but I still like OPUS’s visual quality WAY more…

We need a rematch in Antigravity when we poor Gemini Pro users get access to the CLI version 😂

Which one tells the story better? 👀
How do you like the new Gemini model?

sourceMaterials.text: @yevloop yes, we need a rematch :D not cli is just really bad, tested today more, sucking tokens like crazy without results
sourceMaterials.author: shownotover

sourceMaterials.author: shownotover

sourceMaterials.text: @Nathaiv1 Thank you, and of course it was your idea! Thank you for it! Will share more if we go viral together Bstr! ;)

sourceMaterials.text: @MichaelWaitze nice! thanks for the extra insights!

sourceMaterials.text: @_Ad1_KaM_ yes, should mention that more if not obvious! but to be fair gemini only has like 3 subs and ultra is crazy expensive

sourceMaterials.text: @SeHozaifa Yes, it seems like visually with not overprompting but just one shoot: Opus seems better (and cheaper)
